== Research Notes ==
=== Individual father review, 22 October 2026 ===

This dated review supersedes any earlier grade of this pair within the stated record scope. The existing father [[Glasgow-2581]] is assessed at 94% (proved). The distinctive name supports continuity with the selected family.

Confident compiled lineage identification; the DAR summary remains derivative and its underlying submitted evidence has not been re-inspected here.

Next useful test: Consult the DAR supporting documents if a competing Ferrebee is proposed.
